files.name: CloseIn.java

help: close_in <mob>: after an attack couldn't reach a visible nearby mob, step/jump/swim straight at it into reach
lesson: Attack UNREACHABLE mostly fires at 3-4 blocks when the pathfinder's 'near' goal stalls on a ledge, hole or water; direct key movement toward a visible mob can close that last gap where pathing gives up.
summary: close_in: right after attack fails UNREACHABLE with the mob still in sight nearby, walk/jump/swim straight at it by keys (mining a blocking block) until within 2.8 blocks so the next attack lands
